claims.verbatim:
Steamship Persia (Br), Lott, Liverpool May 19, via Queens-
town 20th, with mdse and 199[?] passengers, to E Cunard. 19th[?]
inst, off Tuskar, passed steamship Africa, from Boston, for
Liverpool; same day, off Queenstown, bark Eddystone (Br);
25th, lat 43[?], lon 44[?], bark Maxwell (Br), bound E; 26th[?], lat
42[?], lon 60[?], steamship Ericsson, hence for Bremen; 27th[?], lat
41[?], lon 69[?], ship Charlotte (Brem), bound W; 29th[?], 2 PM, off
Fire Island, ship Queen Pearl, bound W.
